# Rumble

5 endpoints, all GET. Base URL `https://www.socialcrawl.dev`, auth header `x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY`.

**Credit costs:** 4 standard (1 credit), 1 premium (10) - the exact cost is in each endpoint heading below.

## GET /v1/rumble/channel/videos - 1 credit (standard)

Returns channel metadata, videos, shorts, and a numeric cursor for the next page. Pass either `handle` or `url`.

**Use when** you want to walk one channel's uploads by handle or URL; search looks across every channel by keyword instead.
**Cost** cache 600 s
**Paging** cursor · ≈25/page (observed once) · depth unknown · N items ≈ ceil(N/25) x 1 credits

**Query params**

- `handle` (optional, string) - Rumble channel handle. · e.g. `CuteCats223`
- `url` (optional, string) - Rumble channel URL.
- `cursor` (optional, string) - Cursor from the previous response: the next page number (e.g. `2`).

**Constraints**

- Provide at least one of `handle`, `url`.

**Response** `PostList` rows at `data.items[]`, each `{ computed, post }` ([full schema](schemas/PostList.md))

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `post.url` | Direct URL to the post on the source platform |
| `post.content.text` | Post caption, description, or text content |
| `post.id` | Platform-specific post ID… |
| `post.published_at` | Post creation timestamp as an ISO 8601 UTC string. |
| `post.author.username` | Author username |
| `computed.content_category` | Keyword-classified content category… |

+8 more (types in the full schema): `computed` {engagement_rate, estimated_reach, language}; `post.author` {display_name}; `post.content` {duration_seconds, thumbnail_url}; `post.engagement` {views}; `post.flags` {deleted}. Never filled: `post.author.avatar_url`, `post.author.verified`, `post.content.media_urls`, `post.engagement.comments`, `post.engagement.likes`, `post.engagement.saves`, `post.engagement.shares`, `post.flags.nsfw`, `post.flags.pinned`, `post.flags.spoiler`. Page-level: `data.dropped`.

**Next** `rumble/video/comments` (`url` ← `data.items[].post.url`) - List top-level comments on a Rumble video. · `rumble/video` (`url` ← `data.items[].post.url`) - Get a Rumble video. · `rumble/video/transcript` (`url` ← `data.items[].post.url`) - Get a Rumble video transcript.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/rumble/channel/videos" \
  --data-urlencode "handle=CuteCats223" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/rumble/search - 1 credit (standard)

Searches Rumble videos by keyword. Returns matching videos and shorts with title, URL, thumbnail, channel, published date, view-count text + integer, plus a numeric cursor for the next page.

**Use when** you want to find videos across all of Rumble, passing the returned cursor for the next page; channel/videos covers one named channel.
**Cost** cache 120 s
**Paging** cursor · ≈24/page (observed once) · depth unknown · N items ≈ ceil(N/24) x 1 credits

**Query params**

- `query` (required) - Search query. · e.g. `funny cats`
- `cursor` (optional, string) - Cursor from the previous response: the next page number (e.g. `2`).

**Response** `PostList` rows at `data.items[]`, each `{ computed, post }` ([full schema](schemas/PostList.md))

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `post.url` | Direct URL to the post on the source platform |
| `post.author.username` | Author username |
| `post.content.text` | Post caption, description, or text content |
| `post.id` | Platform-specific post ID… |
| `post.published_at` | Post creation timestamp as an ISO 8601 UTC string. |
| `computed.content_category` | Keyword-classified content category… |

+8 more (types in the full schema): `computed` {engagement_rate, estimated_reach, language}; `post.author` {display_name}; `post.content` {duration_seconds, thumbnail_url}; `post.engagement` {views}; `post.flags` {deleted}. Never filled: `post.author.avatar_url`, `post.author.verified`, `post.content.media_urls`, `post.engagement.comments`, `post.engagement.likes`, `post.engagement.saves`, `post.engagement.shares`, `post.flags.nsfw`, `post.flags.pinned`, `post.flags.spoiler`. Page-level: `data.dropped`.

**Next** `rumble/video/comments` (`url` ← `data.items[].post.url`) - List top-level comments on a Rumble video. · `rumble/video` (`url` ← `data.items[].post.url`) - Get a Rumble video. · `rumble/video/transcript` (`url` ← `data.items[].post.url`) - Get a Rumble video transcript. · `rumble/channel/videos` (`handle` ← `data.items[].post.author.username`) - List videos for a Rumble channel.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/rumble/search" \
  --data-urlencode "query=funny cats" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/rumble/video - 1 credit (standard)

Returns title, description, thumbnail, channel, publish date, view count, likes, dislikes, captions, and media metadata when available.

**Use when** you have a video URL and want that one video in full, rather than a list from search or channel/videos.
**Cost** cache 600 s
**Paging** none

**Query params**

- `url` (required) - Rumble video URL. · e.g. `https://rumble.com/v79xhhm-discovery-example.html`

**Response** `Post` object at `data`, `{ computed, post }` ([full schema](schemas/Post.md))

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `post.url` | Direct URL to the post on the source platform |
| `post.author.username` | Author username |
| `post.content.text` | Post caption, description, or text content |
| `post.id` | Platform-specific post ID… |
| `post.published_at` | Post creation timestamp as an ISO 8601 UTC string. |
| `computed.content_category` | Keyword-classified content category… |

+9 more (types in the full schema): `computed` {engagement_rate, estimated_reach, language}; `post.author` {display_name}; `post.content` {duration_seconds, thumbnail_url}; `post.engagement` {likes, views}; `post.flags` {deleted}. Never filled: `post.author.avatar_url`, `post.author.verified`, `post.content.media_urls`, `post.engagement.comments`, `post.engagement.saves`, `post.engagement.shares`, `post.flags.nsfw`, `post.flags.pinned`, `post.flags.spoiler`.

**Next** `rumble/video/comments` (`url` ← `data.post.url`) - The comments on the video. · `rumble/video/transcript` (`url` ← `data.post.url`) - Get a Rumble video transcript. · `rumble/channel/videos` (`handle` ← `data.post.author.username`) - List videos for a Rumble channel.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/rumble/video" \
  --data-urlencode "url=https://rumble.com/v79xhhm-discovery-example.html" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/rumble/video/comments - 1 credit (standard)

Returns all top-level comments for a Rumble video: comment text, author, `createdAt`, `createdAtText`, `likeCount`, `dislikeCount`, and `replyCount` when comment bodies are public.

**Use when** you want to read a video's comment section, which arrives complete in one response, though replies are not expanded.
**Cost** cache 300 s
**Paging** single page - Fixed-window feed: upstream returns a single non-cursored result set.

**Query params**

- `url` (required) - Rumble video URL. · e.g. `https://rumble.com/v792vns-example.html`

**Response** `CommentList` rows at `data.items[]`, each `{ comment, computed }` ([full schema](schemas/CommentList.md))

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `comment.text` | Comment body. |
| `comment.id` | Platform-specific comment ID (always a string) |
| `comment.published_at` | Comment creation timestamp as an ISO 8601 UTC string. |
| `comment.author.username` | Comment author username (null when tombstoned) |
| `comment.author.avatar_url` | URL to comment author profile picture |
| `comment.author.display_name` | Comment author display name |

+4 more (types in the full schema): `comment.engagement` {likes, replies}; `comment.flags` {deleted}; `computed` {language}. Never filled: `comment.author.verified`, `comment.flags.pinned`, `comment.parent_id`, `comment.post_id`, `comment.url`. Page-level: `data.comment_recency`, `data.dropped`.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/rumble/video/comments" \
  --data-urlencode "url=https://rumble.com/v792vns-example.html" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/rumble/video/transcript - 10 credits (premium)

Returns the transcript for a Rumble video when captions are available. If Rumble doesn't expose captions, `transcript` is `null` and credits are not deducted.

**Use when** you need what was said in a video; video gives you its title, description, and counts but no transcript.
**Cost** cache 2592000 s
**Paging** none

**Query params**

- `url` (required) - Rumble video URL. · e.g. `https://rumble.com/v784xoi-president-donald-j.-trump-and-secwar-pete-hegseth-hold-a-press-conference-a.html`

**Response** `Transcript`. Fields not published yet - call it once; `/v1/utility/endpoint?id=rumble/video/transcript` serves the current contract.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/rumble/video/transcript" \
  --data-urlencode "url=https://rumble.com/v784xoi-president-donald-j.-trump-and-secwar-pete-hegseth-hold-a-press-conference-a.html" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```
